pages.title: Regeneration Kiln
pages.text: A furnace that burns the coke and poisons out of a worn catalyst's pores, and gives it back like new.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Restores worn Zeolite Catalysts. Put the worn catalyst in an input slot (not the catalyst slot); it comes out new.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).
